facts.fact:
The question resolves on the xtracker.io Post Counter for @elonmusk, from Nov 3 12:00 PM ET to Nov 10 12:00 PM ET, 2026.
It counts main-feed posts, quote posts and reposts, and counts replies shown on the main feed.
Pages found in search describe these rules.

A search snippet citing an NBC News analysis says Musk posted about 1,716 times between Sept 17 and Oct 17, 2025, an average of over 55 posts a day.
That is roughly 390 a week and is from 2025, not 2026.

Search results show weekly count brackets for Oct–Nov 2026 weeks, including 80-99, 100-119, 260-279, 300-319 and 500+.
I found no actual weekly counts for 2026 and no count so far for Nov 3–5, 2026.

uncertainties: Actual xtracker counts for Nov 3-5, 2026 and for recent weeks in 2026 are unknown.
Whether Musk's 2026 posting rate is lower than in 2025 is unknown.
Whether tracker counting differs from X, for example deleted posts and community reposts, is unknown.
I could not open xtracker.io; the proxy refused the connection.
The poll and polling-error checklist items do not apply to a tweet-count question, so I did not research them.
